scripts.android: npm run sdk:build && expo run:android --variant demoDebug
scripts.android:sandbox: npm run sdk:build && expo run:android --variant sandboxDebug --app-id id.tracive.sdk.example.rn.sandbox
scripts.android:production: npm run sdk:build && expo run:android --variant productionDebug --app-id id.tracive.sdk.example.rn.production
scripts.ios: npm run sdk:build && expo run:ios --scheme demo --configuration Debug-demo
scripts.ios:sandbox: npm run sdk:build && expo run:ios --scheme sandbox --configuration Debug-sandbox
scripts.ios:production: npm run sdk:build && expo run:ios --scheme production --configuration Debug-production
